newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: L.Lease seen seller of Westpac.
newsitem.headline: L.Lease seen seller of Westpac.

text.p: Brokers said Lend Lease Corp Ltd may have been the seller of Westpac Banking Corp shares due to the involvement of brokerage firm County Natwest, which handled Lend Lease's 1996 warrant issue over Westpac shares.
"The two (companies) may be linked," one broker said.

Lend Lease raised A$365 million last June through a warrant issue over 100 million Westpac shares for A$3.65 per warrent. The group said then it would decide by at least April 1997 on it would to do with the 65 million Westpac shares it kept.
County Natwest crossed 15 million Westpac shares at A$7.00 each earlier on Wednesday.
A spokesman for County Natwest said he could not comment on the trade. A Westpac spokesman said they could not comment either, while nobody from Lend Lease was unavailable for comment.
Under the warrant issue, Lend Lease kept the dividend stream from the 100 million Westpac shares sold in the offer.
At 3.45 p.m. (0545 GMT), Westpac shares were 18 cents down at A$6.93 with 17.49 million shares traded, while Lend Lease shares were down 7.2 cents to A$21.12.
